entranceFee.hu: Várbelépő 6€, sikló 6€, a múzeumok ezen felül fizetendők
entranceFee.ro: Acces castel 6€, lift înclinat 6€, muzeele suplimentar
entranceFee.en: Castle entry €6, inclined lift €6, museums extra

publicTransport.ro: Autobuz regional până la stația Riegersburg Ort
publicTransport.en: Regional bus to Riegersburg Ort stop

parking.de: Mehrere Parkplätze am Fuße des Burgfelsens, meist kostenlos
parking.hu: Több parkoló a várhegy lábánál, többnyire ingyenesek
parking.ro: Mai multe parcări la poalele stâncii castelului, majoritatea gratuite
parking.en: Several parking lots at the foot of the castle rock, mostly free

accessibility.de: Durch den Schräglift barrierefrei erreichbar, in der Burg teilweise Stufen
accessibility.hu: A siklónak köszönhetően akadálymentesen elérhető, a várban helyenként lépcsők
accessibility.ro: Accesibil prin liftul înclinat, în castel există parțial trepte
accessibility.en: Accessible via the inclined lift, some steps within the castle

bestTimeToVisit.de: Nachmittags, passend zur Greifvogel-Flugschau um 15:30 Uhr
bestTimeToVisit.ro: După-amiaza, pentru spectacolul cu păsări de pradă de la ora 15:30
bestTimeToVisit.en: In the afternoon, coinciding with the bird of prey show at 3:30 PM
